requirements.text: Keep the stack: Vite + React + TypeScript + react-router, plain CSS with the design-token theme, and system fonts only.
Every page is prerendered to its own HTML file.
Every prerendered page has its own title.
Every prerendered page has its own meta description.
Every prerendered page has its own Open Graph tags.
Every prerendered page has its own canonical link.
The training filter keeps working after hydration.
The Menu button keeps working after hydration.
The contact form keeps working after hydration.
No backend, analytics, third-party scripts or external CDNs.
Existing acceptance tests keep passing, except where this task changes that behavior.

Brand colors are deep navy #0B1F3A, white, and teal #1F8A8A as the one accent; only tints and shades of these are used (e.g. a darker navy for premium bands, a pale teal-grey for alternate section backgrounds).
Headings use a serif font.
Body text uses a sans-serif font.
The hero h1 uses a display size of about 56-64px on desktop.
The hero h1 uses a display size of about 36-40px on phones.
Spacing uses a consistent 8px spacing scale.
Cards have soft shadows.
Cards lift slightly on hover.
Sections fade/slide in subtly, with no other motion beyond hover lifts.
All motion (section fade/slide-in and hover lifts) is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.
All text meets WCAG AA contrast.
Text over photos meets WCAG AA contrast.

Use only the eight existing photos in public/images/ (hero-boardroom, smb-owner, team-workshop, enterprise-atrium, custom-development, strategy-session, about-office, contact-meeting, each as NAME.jpg 1344x768 and NAME-768.jpg 768x439); do not generate or download images.
Photos are rendered with (or ) with a srcset containing the 768w and 1344w versions.
Photo images have a sizes attribute.
Photo images have width and height attributes.
Photo images have loading="lazy", except the hero photo.
Photo images have decoding="async".
Photo images have descriptive alt text (e.g. "Meeting room with a wall screen showing data visualizations").
Photos are never captioned or presented as the firm's own team or clients.
Where text sits on a photo, a navy gradient overlay is placed behind the text.
Illustrations are inline SVG in the brand colors, with no illustration image files.
Every service item has a line icon.
Every training format has a line icon.
Every engagement tier has a line icon.
Line icons use one consistent style: 24px grid with 1.5-2px strokes.
A subtle background motif of overlapping bell curves or a fine data-grid pattern appears behind the hero.
A subtle background motif of overlapping bell curves or a fine data-grid pattern appears behind the dark bands.
"How we work" uses numbered step markers joined by a line.
Header nav links are Services, Training, Engagements, About, Contact, plus the "Book a consultation" button.
The footer nav lists the same five links: Services, Training, Engagements, About, Contact.
The header is sticky.
Once the page scrolls, the header is white with a hairline bottom border.
On phones the header links collapse into the "Menu" button.
